text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Tunis on Friday to brief Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on the crisis in the Middle East peace process, officials said.
Arafat's spokesman Marwan Kanafani said Arafat will fly immediately after the meeting to Gaza where he is expected to chair a Palestinian Authority cabinet meeting.

The crisis erupted when Israel broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem earlier this month. Clashes broke out afterwards and last Friday, a Palestinian suicide bomber killed three Israeli women at a Tel Aviv cafe.
Arafat was in Rabat on Thursday where he met with U.S. Middle East peace envoy Dennis Ross.
